finding: the bar is reachable, and every route that reaches it requires TT_BIO_OF3_DEVICE_REFATOM ON, which this row measures as a per-fold inference regression on both models of OF3_FAMILY. The charter's own hard constraint is that nothing may change inference's output or slow it down, so the coverage clause as written can only be satisfied by breaking the constraint it sits beside. That is the defect, not the 0.52 points.

proposal.arithmetic: the measured ceiling of the shipped arm is 97.98499306866148; a bar that rounds a measured ceiling UP is unsatisfiable by a perfect artifact, so it rounds DOWN, at the four decimals the current bar carries
proposal.and_keep_the_question_alive: a bar equal to the measured value is a no-regression ratchet, not a proof of coverage. Pair it with the class itemisation below so the 2.0150069313385040 % that is NOT compared stays stated rather than absorbed, and so the number cannot drift down without failing
proposal.not_this_rows_edit: proposed only. _of3t_donecheck.py and CHARTER_EVIDENCE belong to the orchestrator; a row that moves its own bar toward passing is the pattern that gate exists to refuse
